guides.favoredWhen: She dodges Qs, reads ice, and Es only when you E. Vary elements, E unpredictably.

keyTips.text: She dodges your Qs: the blades are the lane, so lead them.
Ice signals gank or all-in: white blade means she backs off, so show it.
She never wastes E: she uses it when you E onto her, so E unpredictably.

tips.text: She concedes the early: your burst out-trades hers, so press.
She sidesteps blades for free HP: hold Q until she commits.
She answers your E with E: bait hers before dashing in.
Ice up means she concedes: press with white blade.
Blades landed plus Es unanswered: the Akali who always dodges never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies 1-2, holds Charm for your engage, and avoids walls after 6. Weather early, engage on Charm downtime.

keyTips.text: She bullies you very hard at levels 1-2 with autos and Q: you have no answer yet, so concede.
She holds Charm for your engage: bait it before all-inning pre-6.
After 6 she keeps away from walls and holds Charm (about {cd:246:R}): fight away from walls.

tips.text: She abuses the first two levels, then sets the wave middle for your 3 spike: crash into it.
She keeps the wave off your side: a long lane is your engage room, so stretch it.
From 6 she roams with priority: match or punish the crash.
She tracks your engage and answers with defensive Charm: engage only on downtime.
She roams with prio: her map pressure beats your duel, so never let her leave free.

guides.favoredWhen: He stays off the wave, never Rs first, and answers engages backwards. Run him down, hold R for his.

keyTips.text: You out-damage him: take the straight trade.
He stays away from his wave: you E through it to reach him, so do.
He never Rs first: you R back and reverse it, so hold yours.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He respects your level-2 burst: press at 2.
He pokes with range and gives no openings: his damage must be free, so close.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
He needs W plus R: R alone gets countered by yours, so bait the shadow first.
Sweeper plus Exhaust: play around his answers, never engage into them.

keyTips.text: Prioritize farming and health through level two, then begin regular trades at level three rather than forcing damage early.
Always clear the wave before roaming: the cleared wave is the window for a kill or an objective, and leaving it uncleared wastes the turn.
In teamfights, hunt a multi-target ultimate when enemies line up, with E-Flash-R as the main engage example; use water Q for the stun, grass Q for concealment, and stone Q for the execute hit.

tips.text: Against a melee opponent with a weak level one, start W, dash in, and land an empowered auto to proc Electrocute; take this only when the early matchup allows it.
Use these openers: E into auto, grass Q, W, water Q, or water Q into W and stone Q; the full all-in adds autos and Ignite around stone Q into W and stone Q.
Run Electrocute as the lane-pressure setup for early trades and pushing out squishy opponents; skip its defensive costs only when the burst plan fits.
Take Conqueror for the longer level-two trade into opponents who stack health: W in, keep auto-attacking, then Q-W-Q for sustained damage over burst.
Chip opponents down and punish their mistakes rather than forcing a full-health one-shot the kit cannot reliably finish.
After clearing mid, turn toward a roam, a kill, or an objective instead of hovering on an empty lane.

Match the build path to the team's need: the assassin path for burst targets, the Conqueror cooldown path for extended fights, or the scaling path with Muramana, Profane Hydra, Death's Dance, and Serylda's Grudge into several tanks.
Enter with E-Flash-R onto a lined-up group, and when no group lines up, remove the enemy carry as the fight-deciding play even without a one-shot.
If a key squishy sits in execute range, prioritize that target over a flashier multi-target angle.
Treat grass Q as the teamfight survival tool: its concealment hides Qiyana through the chaos so she can close and reposition between targets.

itemization.text: Choose Electrocute with Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos, Ultimate Hunter, Presence of Mind, and Last Stand for lane pressure and burst, or Conqueror for repeated autos and extended fights into health-stacking opponents.
Start Doran's Blade with a potion and buy Long Sword, Serrated Dirk, boots, a Control Ward, and Oracle Lens at the first recall.

Build the assassin core of Profane Hydra, Voltaic Cyclosword, Axiom Arc, and Serylda's Grudge; on the Conqueror path start Hubris into Profane Hydra, with Edge of Night, Guardian Angel, Death's Dance, and The Collector as situational picks.
